summary: BHP Group filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) furnishing an exchange release dated 12 November 2026 announcing the appointment of Adrian Wood as Chief Financial Officer effective 17 February 2027, succeeding Vandita Pant, who steps down after the half-year results on 16 February 2027 and stays for transition support until 29 March 2027. Wood, an internal candidate currently VP Projects, Minerals Australia, previously served as VP Finance and Group Investor Relations Officer. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or ownership terms are stated. The succession is planned rather than abrupt; watch disclosure around capital-allocation continuity and any guidance revisions.
